dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: The visible 2D geometric narrowing is rapid and symmetrical from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median pixel value across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low density; localized dark-pixel clusters are concentrated in a narrow longitudinal band along the central dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the pigmented dorsal ridge and the surrounding white epidermal baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct dark longitudinal line along the dorsal ridge and a small, faint transverse linear mark on the mid-left dorsal field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, faint transverse mark located on the mid-left dorsal surface.
